# ONINO

> ONINO is a white-label tokenized financing infrastructure that enables businesses to structure, operate, and monetize digital financing solutions with optional tokenization across the EU and Switzerland.

## About

ONINO GmbH is a fintech company headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany. The company provides a compliant, modular platform for issuing regulated digital securities, onboarding investors, automating compliance (KYC/AML), and managing the full asset lifecycle. ONINO is not a crowdfunding platform — it is the technology and compliance layer that powers financing platforms.

## Products

- **Whitelabel Platform**: Launch a fully branded tokenized financing platform under your own domain. Includes deal structuring, investor management, compliance automation, and regulatory reporting.
- **ONINO Platform**: Operate tokenized financing directly on ONINO's managed infrastructure with faster time to launch and minimal setup.
- **Single Issuance**: Run a single compliant financing round on your own website without needing a license.

## Target Audience

ONINO serves asset managers, banks, financial institutions, investment clubs, cooperatives, and platform operators who need compliant infrastructure for digital financing.

## Industries Served

- Real Estate
- Private Equity
- Renewable Energy / ESG
- Banking and Financial Services

## Regulatory Frameworks

ONINO supports financing structures compliant with:
- BaFin (German Federal Financial Supervisory Authority)
- ECSPR (European Crowdfunding Service Provider Regulation)
- MiCA (Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation)
- GDPR-compliant data handling

## Jurisdictions

Active in 24+ countries including all EU member states and Switzerland.

## Financial Instruments Supported

- Subordinated loans (Nachrangdarlehen)
- Participation rights (Genussrechte)
- Equity tokens
- Bonds
- Custom financial products

## Key Capabilities

- White-label setup in under 24 hours
- Automated KYC/AML and investor eligibility screening
- Multi-jurisdiction regulatory workflows
- Deal structuring and parallel deal management
- End-to-end investor lifecycle management
- Optional tokenization layer for secondary market readiness
- $35M+ already tokenized on the platform
